summary: Frontend-only regression on new /workout-list catalog-detail screen plus /workouts hub. All 8 requested feature groups verified end-to-end at tablet-landscape viewport (1280x800). No functional bugs found. Minor React Native Web deprecation warnings observed (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use 'textShadow'); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); Animated useNativeDriver falling back to JS on web. Cosmetic on web preview but should be cleaned up. Reference: multiple screens (workouts/workout-list toasts and shadows).

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated 'textShadow*' style shorthand with the new 'textShadow' prop and pointerEvents style to silence RN-Web warnings.
Optional: consider setting accessibilityRole='button' on Pressables that use accessibilityState.selected so screen readers/tests can read aria-selected (not required, chips look correct visually).
critical_code_review_comments: workout-list.tsx line 122 uses expression-statement ternary `next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);` — works but eslint-no-unused-expressions may flag. Consider if/else for clarity.
Detail auto-selection effect (line 110-112) correctly reconciles when filters exclude the current selection — verified empty state and re-select behavior.
seed_data_creation: None. Workout catalog is static frontend data in src/lib/workout-catalog.ts (as declared mocked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test at tablet landscape viewport 1280x800 (compact breakpoint is 900px). aria-selected is NOT emitted by Pressable+accessibilityState on RN-Web — verify chip active state via URL params or visible detail content instead of aria attributes. Popular cards navigate with ?workout=<id>, categories with ?type=<id>. Coach persistence uses AsyncStorage per browser context — set via /settings then navigate to /workout-list to verify sidebar/coach card. Start Workout pushes to /workout?title=<name>; Rest Day shows toast 'Enjoy your rest day' instead.
